_source: FIRST Clan Boss reality anchor — in-game RESULT screen (user capture 2026-08-05). Demon Lord HARD, DonaHilvi's pool team (Michelangelo/Ninja/Hilvi/Mausoleum Mage/Artak), full-auto. Per-hero rows are dealt / taken / healed from the result screen. This is the ground truth to calibrate the CB sim (lib/sim/clan_boss.js) against.
_findings: HP BURN is the carry, via NINJA (not direct/lifesteal — corrected 2026-08-05). Ninja A2 Hailburn places up to 3 [HP Burn] (75%/hit, 3t) AND instantly activates all [HP Burn] on the boss; A3 Cyan Slash ignores 50% boss DEF and cuts Hailburn's cooldown by 1 → he spams the place+activate loop. So most of Ninja's 4.95M is HP-Burn damage; Artak (also HP Burn) adds part of his 639k. Sim v0 credited ~6.3M HP burn vs reality's ~4.5-5M → ~1.3x over, from the MISSING 'only one HP Burn on the boss at a time' constraint (sim ticks Ninja's + Artak's burns simultaneously; reality holds one). So the sim is DIRECTIONALLY RIGHT (HP burn = carry) and ~30-40% high, NOT 10x off — the single-HP-Burn fix is the calibration lever. lifesteal healed (Ninja 754k) is off that burn+direct damage.
